g.text: Actors on the Verge of Losing SAG-AFTRA Health Insurance Find Support via ‘One Job Away’ Instagram Campaign: ‘The System Is Not Working’ ◆ Georgia Juvelis to Step Down as Chief Communications Officer for AMC Global Media ◆ ‘Coven Academy’ Renewed for Season 2 at Disney ◆ ‘Baywatch’ Reboot Sets January Premiere Date on Fox ◆ Bill Nighy Joins Caitriona Balfe in Alfonso Cuaron Series ‘Ascension’ at Apple TV ◆ Lisa Ling Signs With CAA ◆
